name: Worlds Teleporter UI
summary: Editable green-stud Worlds window with five world entries, a scrolling list, close control and Teleport buttons. Entry artwork areas render black in this session.
install: Create a ScreenGui under StarterGui and import Worlds inside it. Preview clones used AnchorPoint (0.5, 0.5) and Position (0.5, 0.5). Configure entry labels and your own artwork. Connect close/navigation controls and implement server-validated teleport destinations and unlock checks; none are supplied.
limits: Static layout inspected in Studio Play on temporary clones at 1325 x 761; panel visibility and scroll positions were set manually. No gameplay handlers are included. No mobile/gamepad testing. Native files are unchanged. No teleport implementation, destination IDs or world-unlock logic. Black world-artwork areas remain unresolved; no successful artwork loading is claimed.
credit: Original supplied filename retains TU wording; original author not independently established.
verification: Static layout preview in Studio Play on temporary clones; no original scripts are present. Panel visibility and scrolling were set manually, not by working navigation. Native instance counts/root names matched the supplied imports. Viewport 1325 x 761; desktop only.
